design_objective: One integrated, modular, offline-first personal AI application with replaceable AI providers and locally controlled data.
architecture_principles: Explicit user approval for consequential actions

system_overview.network_dependency: Internet is optional for essential local functionality

application_layers.name: Presentation Layer
application_layers.responsibility: Provide the central dashboard and user interface.

application_layers.name: Application Layer
application_layers.responsibility: Coordinate application functions and manage interactions between modules.

application_layers.name: AI Orchestration Layer
application_layers.responsibility: Coordinate AI requests, specialist agents and external tools.

application_layers.name: Integration Layer
application_layers.responsibility: Connect replaceable AI providers, local models and authorized external services.

application_layers.name: Data Layer
application_layers.responsibility: Store, retrieve, organize and protect application data.

application_layers.name: Security and Permission Layer
application_layers.responsibility: Enforce user permissions, data protection and approval requirements.

ai_agent_architecture.coordination_model: Central coordination with delegated specialist tasks

agents.name: Main Agent
agents.responsibility: Understand requests, coordinate agents and maintain overall task direction.

agents.name: Specialist Agents
agents.responsibility: Perform defined tasks within authorized functional domains.

agents.name: Control Agent
agents.responsibility: Check permissions, security, consistency and compliance.

agents.name: Documentalist
agents.responsibility: Maintain documentation, decisions and knowledge continuity.

rules: Agents operate only within assigned permissions.
Agents must not silently expand their authority.
Consequential actions require explicit user approval.
The user retains final decision-making authority.

functional_modules.name: Personal Dashboard
functional_modules.purpose: Provide one central overview of daily information and activities.

functional_modules.name: Daily Management
functional_modules.purpose: Organize appointments, tasks, reminders and planning.

functional_modules.name: Communication
functional_modules.purpose: Support email and other communication workflows with approval-controlled external actions.

functional_modules.name: Knowledge Management
functional_modules.purpose: Organize, search and retrieve documents, knowledge and certificates.

functional_modules.name: Project Management
functional_modules.purpose: Manage projects, progress, research and documentation.

functional_modules.name: Health and Wellbeing
functional_modules.purpose: Support physical wellbeing, sleep, energy, self-care and mental wellbeing.

functional_modules.name: Creative Work
functional_modules.purpose: Support writing, publications and creative projects.

functional_modules.name: Community Initiatives
functional_modules.purpose: Support Heal the World Project, AI Vision and Funsum.

functional_modules.name: Automation
functional_modules.purpose: Reduce repetitive work through controlled and approved workflows.

limitations: Storage can be cleared by the browser or user

data_rules: Do not rely on browser storage as the only permanent backup.

offline_architecture.goal: Essential application functionality remains available without an internet connection.
offline_architecture.rule: Internet-dependent features must not prevent essential local functionality from working.

communication_between_components.principle: Use defined interfaces and structured data contracts.

rules: Avoid rebuilding from scratch without justification.
Build and test one manageable component at a time.

proposed: Service Worker for offline application functionality
not_yet_decided: Database implementation beyond current browser storage

next_actions: Inventory installed software and available development tools.
Verify the proposed architecture against the actual computer environment.
